_comment: ALT-ROCK progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law -- docs/idiom-research/legal.md); these are the harmonic families of 90s alternative from genre-rock-pop.md section A2: the aeolian anthem i-bVI-bVII, the quiet-loud four-chord minor loop, riff-over-static pedal i, the pop-rock axis I-V-vi-IV and its vi rotation, the mixolydian I-bVII-IV, and a sus4 lift on the V. Power chords omit the 3rd, so the qualities here mainly steer the bass and the melody's blue zone. Plain triads only -- no jazz extensions (corny trap).
